items.title: Alarm.com (ALRM) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Split Analyst Revisions
items.summary: The latest update for Alarm.com Holdings lifts the fair value estimate from US$70 to US$73, which feeds into a cluster of Street price targets that now runs from around US$70 to US$80, alongside JPMorgan’s lower US$50 view. This spread reflects different opinions on how much sector deal activity and the SaaS mix are already reflected in the stock, as well as how durable the recent hardware strength might be. items.summary: The fair value estimate for Edgewise Therapeutics has shifted from US$54.00 to about US$56.17 per share, putting fresh attention on how analysts are updating their models. Much of this reflects new Street work on EDG-7500 in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, along with clearer plans for Phase 3 trials and recent regulatory feedback that shape views on valuation, capital allocation, and execution risk. items.title: Raymond James bullish on Schwab amid ‘compelling valuation’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Raymond James upgraded Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) to Strong Buy with a $135 price target in a note on Wednesday, telling investors that the brokerage is a clear winner from interest rates staying higher for longer.
